Toys & models

10 LEGO aviation sets to consider for airplane fans

LEGO aviation gifts range from simple play sets to large display builds. A younger builder who wants to move passengers around an airport needs a different gift from an adult who wants an airliner on a shelf. These ten sets appear in LEGO’s aviation collection; availability can change.

By Pilot Gift Guide Updated 2026-10-20

How we choose our recommendations
In this guideThe ideasHow to chooseMore gift ideas

The ideas

Our selections prioritize personal relevance, usefulness, and fit for the recipient. Named products and destinations link to official sources where applicable.

  1. 1

    Concorde

    Our first choice to investigate for an adult who loves recognizable airliners. Think about the eventual display location before choosing a substantial model.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  2. 2

    Douglas DC-3 PAN AM Airliner

    A good direction for a fan of historic airline imagery. Ask whether that aircraft and airline era appeal to them specifically.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  3. 3

    Airport with Airplane

    Consider this for a builder who enjoys the whole airport scene. It offers a different gift experience from a single display aircraft.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  4. 4

    Passenger Airplane

    A straightforward theme for someone interested in everyday airline travel. Check the particular edition instead of assuming every passenger-plane set is identical.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  5. 5

    Coast Guard Helicopter

    A rotorcraft option for a fan who prefers rescue stories to airline scenes. Choose according to their interest, not merely box size.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  6. 6

    Emergency Air Ambulance Airplane

    Consider this when rescue-themed play is the attraction. Check the builder’s age and whether they already own a similar aircraft.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  7. 7

    Flatbed Truck with Helicopter

    A useful direction for a child who likes both vehicles and aircraft. The mixed theme may matter more than aviation realism.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  8. 8

    Fire Rescue Helicopter

    Investigate this for a smaller building project. The recipient’s attention span and interests should guide the choice alongside the manufacturer’s age label.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  9. 9

    Passenger Jet

    A potential starting point for a younger builder interested in flying. Confirm the specific product’s age recommendation and small-parts guidance before purchasing.

    Details at lego.com ↗
  10. 10

    First Time at the Airport

    An airport-themed option in the younger-child range. Choose with a caregiver and follow the product’s age guidance rather than adapting an older-child set.

    Details at lego.com ↗

How to choose

Match the maker’s age guidance, the recipient’s building experience, and the finished footprint. The ranking below is our gift shortlist, not a build-quality test. Check the exact set number, current contents, and dimensions on LEGO’s site before choosing, especially when similar names appear across generations.

Prices and availability can change. Check the exact model, delivered total and return terms with the seller. Our recommendations are researched editorial selections, not hands-on test results.
